headline: LLMs embedded in modular agents and reasoning pipelines for molecular drug design
label: Llm Agents For Drug Discovery
summary: Composed LLM agent systems, not only base models, are now being built and evaluated for early-stage drug discovery tasks.
synthesis: The shared thread is that LLMs are placed inside external structure rather than used as standalone text generators. A published modular agent chains retrieval, RAG question answering, molecule generation, 75-property prediction, iterative refinement, and Boltz-2 complex prediction for early-stage drug discovery. DrugR adds step-by-step pharmacological reasoning to molecule optimization and reports improved ADMET properties while preserving efficacy. Beyond SMILES evaluates agentic systems on synthesis planning, literature mining, and molecular design. DrugPlayGround benchmarks LLMs and embeddings on drug characteristics, synergism, drug-protein interactions, and perturbation responses. What is new is that composed systems, not only the underlying models, are becoming the object of evaluation.
